text:
Clara Z: Need a small creative set for the "Serving Wins" webinar/inbound funnel. Ask: 1) modular hero (deck + social crop) that works as a static PNG and a 3s GIF, 2) four microcards: throughput, p95 tail, unit cost, developer time-to-launch, 3) single anonymized benchmark snapshot slide with short methodology note, 4) social header images (two variants) and email header optimized for <200KB. Deadline: Tue 11am PT.

Omar J: Can we squeeze developer time-to-launch card in? Great metric to show ops savings. Also want social copy variants for A/B testing.

Clara Z: yes, include dev time tile: "~40% faster to production" (aggregate stat). Social copy: short (<=140 chars) + longer (one-liner) variants — I'll add copy doc.

DesignHive: request: exact copy for each card, logo lockups, and preferred palette. We'll deliver SVG masters, PNG at 2x, and GIF 1200x628 3s loop. Also confirm email size constraint and if animated GIF allowed in email.

BrandBot: accessibility note: accent #1574DF okay for large headings, but captions at 12px fail AA. Use #0C45A2 for small text or set to 14px. Also add ALT text, 8px logo padding, and provide a grayscale-safe variant for print. Include accessible color-blind palette.

Priya (Legal): legal guidance: avoid definitive promises, use approximate language (e.g., "~40%" or "up to"). No customer-identifying numbers. Bench snapshot must include a short methodology blurb and TM footer. No competitor logos.

Omar J: For benchmarking snapshot, anonymized datapoints: baseline hosting = 1.0x cost, 120ms median, 10k qps; serving config = ~0.65x cost, 95ms median, 13k qps. Present as % deltas.

DesignHive: noted. We'll propose two hero directions: A) schematic flow (request -> cache/batch -> result) for GIF, and B) stacked comparative bars for deck. We'll produce an email-optimized hero (600x200) under 200KB, plus social crops (1200x628). ETA first pass: Mon 4pm PT.

BrandBot: compliance checklist: 1) AA contrast for text sizes used, 2) ALT text for exports, 3) accessible palette, 4) TM footer on bench slide, 5) email size <=200KB, 6) separate localization-ready text layers.

DesignHive: will include localization layers (EN + PT/ES/DE), README with filenames and export settings, and an accessibility variant. Will tag frames: HERO_FLOW, HERO_BARS, CARD_THROUGHPUT, CARD_P95, CARD_TCO, CARD_DEV_TIME, BENCH_SNAPSHOT, SOCIAL_HEADER_A, SOCIAL_HEADER_B, README.

Clara Z: perfect. I'll upload final copy and the brief doc to the campaign drive and tag you. Please tag me in figma comments with "Ready for review" when first pass is up. Thanks :sparkles:

DesignHive: will upload by Mon 4pm PT. Ping us here for any blocker.
